payload.body: Read of cc/mc1126 at 0bd47f17: SOUND after F1; F2 for the run. Full read ~/Devel/scratch/utilz-ic/mc1126-read/read-mc.md (1504cb8f). F1 (fix): mc.lua returns performAction's own result (an element, or false with no reason) where hs.spaces returns true, or nil and a reason; false leaves exec_create_space's why nil and WP A's remove a bare false. A one-desktop display's tile has no AXRemoveDesktop (mcdiag2), so it happens. Fix: one MC.press(el, action) that gives true or nil and a reason, with an mc_test arm. F2 (run): mcdiag2 never read the closed tree and closed with Escape, so (a) closed WindowManager holds no mc.display and (b) a second toggle closes it are unmeasured; the run logs find_any before the open and after each close. Nits N1, N2 in the file. The shape, the tile actions, the reasons and the fakes hold.
